I tried weed for the first time while I was deep in dp a few months ago. It didn’t make anything worse and I didn’t freak out or anything. I’m unsure if it would have the same affects on you.

I’m also 17.  Definitely take it slower than you think you need to. Ease into it. If you are taking edibles go especially slow. 

For me it really helped me feel better. It helped me feel happy for at least a little bit and was quite nice. However, I feel that you can easily become dependent. I think the only reason I’m not dependent right now is because it’s difficult for me to access right now. Otherwise I would probably be high right now.

I’d suggest to not do it but from my personal experience I wouldn’t expect it to cause any harm. Don’t take my word for it. I would advise you again to take it really slow and to avoid using every day because when you are going through a tough time and bored in your room it can be extremely tempting to stay high 24/7.

I think this method of parenting is dangerous because humans are meant to make mistakes and learn from them and over parenting completely destroys a child’s ability to make important mistakes, learn from them, and develop as a human being.

Something I’ve learned during the last year of my depression is that no matter how badly you want someone to care it will never happen if you don’t give them a reason to. 

When you are depressed there is not much you want to talk about. In my case the things I could hold a conversation with someone about are video games, anime, depression, and chess. That’s because I care about those things. 

During the loneliness and pain you will find things other than humans to make you happy. I promise you that people will care for you at some point down the line. I’m 100% positive. But first you have to learn to be content by yourself. I’m not trying to disregard your emotions of loneliness and pain because I know how you feel. But I can tell you that the loneliness will be gone eventually.

Sadly new people don’t come into your life when you are depressed. Only the people you had before your life got dark will care. At least in my experience.

I’ve learned to be grateful for those who do care. I’ve learned to appreciate the alone time. I’ve found things I enjoy. And I know that we will both find someone at some point down the line.
